ASTRA-S09.title: NatureFlex film grade summary N100
ASTRA-S09.scope: Manufacturer family technical sheet hosted by exhibition
ASTRA-S09.findings: NVS30 yield 23.3 m2/kg; NVS45 yield 15.5 m2/kg. 1000/yield gives basis weight. Heat-seal temperature columns are 0.5-second process settings, not service temperatures.

ASTRA-S10.title: NatureFlex film range
ASTRA-S10.findings: Range includes coated and uncoated cellulose, proprietary barrier layers, and separate ovenable grades; grease/oil barrier and transparency are grade-dependent.
ASTRA-S10.limitations: No exact Gaia liner grade or mass; no generic permission to put NVS45 in oven.

ASTRA-S11.title: ADCOTE laminating-adhesive coating weights
ASTRA-S11.findings: ADCOTE102A lists 1.2-2.0 lb/ream; ADCOTE102E 1.2-2.5. Using explicitly assumed 3000 ft2 packaging ream gives approximately 1.95-4.07 g/m2. Supports nonzero order-of-magnitude coating budget.
ASTRA-S11.limitations: Not a Gaia adhesive or compostability/food-contact analogue; modeled coverage/chemistry remains ASSUMED.

ASTRA-S15.title: Tray dimensions table

disclosures: Software cannot certify food safety, legal compliance, or approve procurement.
All 48 evaluated packaging paths require physical and safety qualification before commercial use.
Zero candidates are approved for procurement or confirmed as qualified survivors.
Primary workflow (POST_COOK_HOT_HOLD_6H) is an ASSUMED operational model; hot-fill temperatures and holding criteria are unconfirmed.
No verified plastic-saving claim is established against Profi incumbent; comparisons are indicative screening models.
Missing evidence (UNKNOWN) is non-compensatory and never treated as zero.

ASTRA-S09.title: NatureFlex film grade summary N100
ASTRA-S09.scope: Manufacturer family technical sheet hosted by exhibition
ASTRA-S09.findings: NVS30 yield 23.3 m2/kg; NVS45 yield 15.5 m2/kg. 1000/yield gives basis weight. Heat-seal temperature columns are 0.5-second process settings, not service temperatures.
ASTRA-S09.limitations: Material-mass analogue only; not a nominated Gaia or BIOPAP hot-hold grade.

ASTRA-S10.title: NatureFlex film range
ASTRA-S10.findings: Range includes coated and uncoated cellulose, proprietary barrier layers, and separate ovenable grades; grease/oil barrier and transparency are grade-dependent.
ASTRA-S10.limitations: No exact Gaia liner grade or mass; no generic permission to put NVS45 in oven.

ASTRA-S11.title: ADCOTE laminating-adhesive coating weights
ASTRA-S11.findings: ADCOTE102A lists 1.2-2.0 lb/ream; ADCOTE102E 1.2-2.5. Using explicitly assumed 3000 ft2 packaging ream gives approximately 1.95-4.07 g/m2. Supports nonzero order-of-magnitude coating budget.
ASTRA-S11.limitations: Not a Gaia adhesive or compostability/food-contact analogue; modeled coverage/chemistry remains ASSUMED.

ASTRA-S09.title: NatureFlex film grade summary N100
ASTRA-S09.scope: Manufacturer family technical sheet hosted by exhibition
ASTRA-S09.findings: NVS30 yield 23.3 m2/kg; NVS45 yield 15.5 m2/kg. 1000/yield gives basis weight. Heat-seal temperature columns are 0.5-second process settings, not service temperatures.
ASTRA-S09.limitations: Material-mass analogue only; not a nominated Gaia or BIOPAP hot-hold grade.

ASTRA-S10.title: NatureFlex film range
ASTRA-S10.findings: Range includes coated and uncoated cellulose, proprietary barrier layers, and separate ovenable grades; grease/oil barrier and transparency are grade-dependent.
ASTRA-S10.limitations: No exact Gaia liner grade or mass; no generic permission to put NVS45 in oven.

ASTRA-S11.title: ADCOTE laminating-adhesive coating weights
ASTRA-S11.findings: ADCOTE102A lists 1.2-2.0 lb/ream; ADCOTE102E 1.2-2.5. Using explicitly assumed 3000 ft2 packaging ream gives approximately 1.95-4.07 g/m2. Supports nonzero order-of-magnitude coating budget.
ASTRA-S11.limitations: Not a Gaia adhesive or compostability/food-contact analogue; modeled coverage/chemistry remains ASSUMED.
